subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should this be fixed narrowly in the Telegram plain-group updateLastRoute path, or by adopting a broader shared non-direct delivery-context fallback?
rationale: Both paths are plausible: the narrow Telegram fix matches this report, while the shared fallback could address adjacent channels but changes cross-channel session routing behavior.

options.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
options.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof, then persist the group last route in Telegram without changing shared fallback behavior unless the proof points there.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Refresh the shared recorder approach so non-direct sessions derive delivery context when callers omit updateLastRoute, after compatibility review across channel plugins.

options.title: Wait for live evidence
options.body: Keep this blocked until maintainers can reproduce the current-main Telegram restart path and separate transcript persistence from route persistence.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
recommendation.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof, then persist the group last route in Telegram without changing shared fallback behavior unless the proof points there.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared inbound session recorder that history ties to steipete while also affecting Telegram route behavior.
